design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g. #003366) for table headers, pull-quote rule, and sidebar border.
Financials table: align numbers right, use hairline rules between rows, bold the total row if any.
Industry snapshot stat strip: three stat blocks in a row, each with a large number and a small label below.
Split bar: a horizontal bar with two coloured segments, left 30% (organised) and right 70% (unorganised), with labels inside or below.
Pull-quote: set in a larger serif font, italic, with a thick left rule in accent colour.
Sidebar: box with a thin border, background tint (e.g. 5% of accent colour), smaller body text.
No decorative imagery or icons; rely on typography and rules for visual hierarchy.

industry_snapshot.after_paragraph: The Indian specialty chemicals market (excluding agrochemicals and dyestuff) was estimated at ₹1,000 billion in FY2017[^drhp-p92], growing at 10-12% CAGR from FY2014 to FY2017[^drhp-p94].
industry_snapshot.rationale: Industry size, growth, and fragmentation are key context; a stat strip and split bar convey them instantly.
